name: Go to Welcome Organization Info Slide
purpose: Welcome wizard button: checks the person fields (script 495), then slides to the Organization Info slide and puts the cursor in the owner name field.
open_question: This script validates the person and 481 validates the organization, although the names suggest the reverse; the order of the slides decides. Layout objects and animation are UI only.

name: Go to Welcome Contact Info Slide
purpose: Welcome wizard button: checks the organization name (script 496), then slides to the Contact Info slide and puts the cursor in the first name field.

name: Create Welcome Initial Parties
purpose: Finishes the welcome wizard. Validates the person, then through the controller API creates the organization (and sets it as the system owner), the first employee, and a User linked to that person with the current account name. Marks initial setup done, stores the user on the session and slides to System Settings. Stops with a dialog on the first error.
reads:
UtilityParty::OrganizationName#4 (step 13)
UtilityParty::OrgAddressLine1#8, OrgAddressLine2#9, OrgCity#10, OrgCountry#11, OrgCounty#12, OrgPostalCode#13, OrgStateProvince#14, OrgPhone#15, OrgWebsite#16 (steps 14-16)
UtilityParty::PersonFirstName#1, PersonJobTitle#19, PersonLastName#3, PersonPhone#17, PersonEmail#18 (steps 40-45, 65)
writes:
UtilityParty::OrganizationId#20 (step 30, current record)
System::OwnerId#39 (step 31, related via System)
UtilityParty::PersonId#21 (step 61, current record)
User::PartyId#12 (step 62, related via User)
System::InitialSetupDoneInd#65 (step 79, related via System)
Organization, Employee and User records created by scripts 253, 164 and 500 in karbon_kontroller (steps 20, 49, 67)
calls:
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/495 (step 4)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/253 (step 20, in karbon_kontroller)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/164 (step 49, in karbon_kontroller)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/500 (step 67, in karbon_kontroller)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/54 (step 81)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/515 (step 83)
open_question: Each controller call runs in its own API transaction; a failure at the employee or user step leaves the organization already created, and a retry would create a second organization. System::OwnerId is set from the client side, not by the API. The person JSON passes several unset variables ($Comments, $Id and so on), so those keys are empty. The user is created with Get(AccountName) of the logged-in FileMaker account, and the first user's privileges are not set here. Needs a check that the layout trigger runs this only once (InitialSetupDoneInd).

name: Go to Welcome Slide
purpose: Opens the Welcome Wizard layout: shows all records, creates the single utility record if none exists, hides menus and toolbars, resizes the window and animates from the welcome text to the Organization Info slide.
writes: UtilityParty: new record (New Record/Request step 6, only when the table is empty)
open_question: Creates a UtilityParty record when there are none; the table looks like a scratch table for the wizard (confirm whether it is a global or utility table).

name: Validate Welcome Person
purpose: Checks that the wizard has the person first name, last name and email. If not, shows "Please complete the required fields." and halts; otherwise clears the required-fields flag and returns 1.
open_question: Halt Script (step 6) inside an If stops the whole calling script. The same required fields must be enforced server-side when the first employee is created.

name: Validate Welcome Organization
purpose: Checks that the wizard has an organization name. If not, shows "Please enter a company name." and halts; otherwise clears the required-fields flag and returns 1.
open_question: Halt Script (step 6) inside an If stops the whole calling script.

name: Go to Welcome System Settings
purpose: Slides the welcome wizard to the System Settings slide and puts the cursor in the area code field.

name: Go to Admin Integrations
purpose: Opens the Admin Integrations page through Admin Nav and shows the message "We encourage you to sign up for some integrations."
